description: Get the company frequency cap: the most marketing emails (campaigns plus marketing sequence emails) one contact may receive in a rolling window. frequencyCap is null when no cap is set. Only sequences with frequencyCapEnabled respect it: their email steps are skipped for a contact already at the cap, and the contact moves to the next step. Campaigns count toward the cap but always send. Transactional emails never count and are never skipped.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_frequency_cap

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_frequency_cap` MCP tool.

frequencyCap.description: The company cap {maxEmails, windowHours}: at most maxEmails marketing emails per contact in any windowHours. Null when no cap is set.
